units.source_text: “良家女子倒不算什么，艺妓在这偏远的山沟里还能这样认真练习，

en.t: It would be one thing if she were a respectable young lady, but for a geisha to practice so earnestly even here in this remote mountain valley,

units.source_text: 乐谱店的老板知道了也会高兴的吧。”

en.t: the music shop owner would be pleased if he knew about it, wouldn't he?
